name: marker
description: Pointer-based access to markers — the moving carriers that track where caved material came from and where it went. Markers are created lazily as caving proceeds, so the set grows during `massflow compute`.
notes: `massflow.marker.type` returns an integer: -2 unbulked for IMZ growth, -1 unbulked for collapse, 0 unbulked for rilling, 1 partially bulked, 2 fully bulked, 3 air.
`massflow.marker.active.tolerance` is a global setting, readable and writable, not a per-marker value.
An intrinsic whose signature ends in `:= <type>` can be assigned to, not just read.

`massflow.marker.moved-day` and `massflow.marker.moved-cycle` cannot be written in a FISH expression: the parser reads the hyphen as subtraction and fails with `massflow.marker.moved is not recognized as a library function`. They are listed by `fish list intrinsics` all the same.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.above
intrinsics.description: Get the marker above in the column

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.active
intrinsics.description: Get the active state of a marker. A marker is considered active if it has moved vertically downward during the current period. See massflow.marker.active.tolerance.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.active.tolerance
intrinsics.description: Get/set the displacement tolerance that determines whether or not a marker is considered active. A marker is considered active if it has moved vertically downward more than the tolerance during the current period. The default value is 0.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.below
intrinsics.description: Get the marker below in the column

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.birthday
intrinsics.description: Get the day at which the marker was formed

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.disp
intrinsics.description: v = massflow.marker.disp(mm) Get the marker total accumulated displacement.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.extra
intrinsics.description: massflow.marker.extra(mm,int>) := a Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the marker. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.find
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the marker with internally assigned ID number i. If no marker exists with that ID number, then null is returned.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.fragment.diameter
intrinsics.description: Get the fragment diameter associated with this marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.friction
intrinsics.description: Get the friction associated with this marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.group
intrinsics.description: massflow.marker.group(mm,slot>) := s Get/set the group name assigned to marker mm in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.id
intrinsics.description: Get the ID of a marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.list
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the container of all markers in the model.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.mass
intrinsics.description: Get the mass associated with this marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.mineblock
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the mineblock that contains a given marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.num
intrinsics.description: Get the total number of markers in the model.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.origin
intrinsics.description: Get the the position of the marker at the time it was created.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.porosity
intrinsics.description: Get the porosity associated with this marker.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.pos
intrinsics.description: v = massflow.marker.pos(mm) Get the marker position.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.pos.lastperiod
intrinsics.description: Get the position of the marker at the end of the previous period.

intrinsics.name: massflow.marker.type
intrinsics.description: Get the current marker type as an integer. The types are as follows: -2: unbulked for IMZ growth -1: unbulked for collapse 0: unbulked for rilling 1: partially bulked 2: fully bulked 3: air
